# Free Logo Design

> > Free Logo Design is a trusted online platform serving 30M+ businesses with AI-powered and professional logo creation tools, branding kits, and design inspiration across multiple industries.

Free Logo Design offers both automated logo creation through AI technology and professional custom design services. The platform provides comprehensive branding solutions including logo makers, design templates, brand kits, and industry-specific inspiration galleries to help entrepreneurs and small businesses establish their visual identity.
